author: Akien
acted_on_note: /cairnhelp skill already exists at ~/.claude/skills/cairnhelp/ — lists all installed skills with names and descriptions. Idea was implemented before this scan.
prose: Akien could not remember the skill name for reorienting on a new task mid-session. He tried "carnhelp" and "workflow" before giving up and asking CC. The lived symptom: 13 installed skills with domain-specific names, no discovery surface — you have to already know the name to use it. The need: /cairnhelp or similar that lists available skills with their names and one-line descriptions.
